units.locator: Article 20.1. Petty hooliganism

units.label: Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Petty hooliganism
units.text: 1. Petty hooliganism, that is, a breach of public order expressing manifest disrespect for society and accompanied by obscene language in public places, offensive harassment of citizens, or the destruction of or damage to another person’s property —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Petty hooliganism
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20.1 · “shall entail an administrative fine of five hundred to one…”

units.locator: Article 20.1. Petty hooliganism
units.text: 2. The same acts involving disobedience to a lawful demand of a representative of the authorities or another person performing duties to protect public order or putting a stop to a breach of public order —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Petty hooliganism
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to two thousand five hundred roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.1 · “shall entail an administrative fine of one thousand to two…”

units.locator: Article 20.1. Petty hooliganism
units.text: 3. Dissemination in information and telecommunications networks, including the Internet, of information expressing, in an indecent form that offends human dignity and public morals, manifest disrespect for society, the state, the official state symbols of the Russian Federation, the Constitution of the Russian Federation or bodies exercising state power in the Russian Federation, except in the cases provided for by Article 20.3.1 of this Code, if these acts do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Petty hooliganism
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 20.1 · “shall entail an administrative fine of thirty thousand to one…”

units.locator: Article 20.1. Petty hooliganism
units.text: 4. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by part 3 of this Article —
units.label: Part 4 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Petty hooliganism
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one hundred thousand to two hundred thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 20.1 · “shall entail an administrative fine of one hundred thousand to…”

units.locator: Article 20.1. Petty hooliganism
units.text: 5. Acts provided for by part 3 of this Article committed by a person who has previously been subjected to an administrative penalty for a similar administrative offence more than twice —
units.label: Part 5 Art. 20.1

units.locator: Article 20.1. Petty hooliganism
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of two hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 20.1 · “shall entail an administrative fine of two hundred thousand to…”

units.locator: Article 20.1. Petty hooliganism
units.text: Note. The prosecution authorities of the Russian Federation shall be notified within twenty-four hours of every instance of initiation of proceedings concerning administrative offences provided for by parts 3 - 5 of this Article.
units.label: Art. 20.1 · “Note. The prosecution authorities of the Russian Federation…”

units.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket
units.text: 1. Violation by the organizer of a public event of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket, except in the cases provided for by parts 2 - 4 and 9 of this Article —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 20.2

units.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten thousand to twenty thousand roubles or compulsory work for up to forty hours; for officials, fifteen thousand to thirty thousand roubles; for legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.

units.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket
units.text: 1.1. Involving a minor in participation in an unauthorized assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket, if this act does not constitute a criminally punishable act —
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 20.2

units.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty thousand to fifty thousand roubles, or compulsory work for twenty to one hundred hours, or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days; for officials, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, two hundred fifty thousand to five hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 20.2 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty…”

units.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket
units.text: 2. Organizing or conducting a public event without submitting notification of the public event in the established manner, except in the cases provided for by part 7 of this Article —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.2

units.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles, or compulsory work for up to fifty hours, or administrative arrest for up to ten days; for officials, twenty thousand to forty thousand roubles; for legal entities, seventy thousand to two hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 20.2 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of twenty…”

units.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket
units.text: 3. Acts (omissions) provided for by parts 1 and 2 of this Article that result in interference with the functioning of life-support facilities, transport or social infrastructure or communications, the movement of pedestrians and/or vehicles, or citizens’ access to residential premises or transport or social infrastructure facilities, or in exceeding the maximum permitted occupancy of an area (premises), if these acts (omissions) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —

units.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

units.label: Part 3 Art. 20.2 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of thirty…”

units.text: 4. Acts (omissions) provided for by parts 1 and 2 of this Article that cause harm to a person’s health or property, if these acts (omissions) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
units.label: Part 4 Art. 20.2

units.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one hundred thousand to three hundred thousand roubles, or compulsory work for up to two hundred hours, or administrative arrest for up to twenty days; for officials, two hundred thousand to six hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, four hundred thousand to one million roubles.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 20.2 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of one hundred…”

units.label: Part 5 Art. 20.2

units.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

units.text: 6. Acts (omissions) provided for by part 5 of this Article that cause harm to a person’s health or property, if these acts (omissions) do not constitute a criminally punishable act —
units.label: Part 6 Art. 20.2

units.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

units.label: Part 6.1 Art. 20.2 · “shall entail an administrative fine for citizens of ten…”

units.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket
units.text: 6.2. Use during a public event of the distinctive sign (attribute) of a media representative provided for by part 5 of Article 6 of Federal Law of 19 June 2004 No. 54-ФЗ ‘On Assemblies, Rallies, Demonstrations, Marches and Pickets’ by a person not entitled to use it —
units.label: Part 6.2 Art. 20.2

units.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of twenty thousand to thirty thousand roubles.

units.text: 7. Organizing or conducting an unauthorized assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket in the immediate vicinity of the territory of a nuclear installation, radiation source or storage facility for nuclear materials and radioactive substances, or actively participating in such public events, if this impedes the performance of official duties by employees of the installation, source or facility or creates a threat to the safety of the population and the environment —
units.label: Part 7 Art. 20.2

units.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket
units.text: shall entail an administrative fine of one hundred fifty thousand to three hundred thousand roubles or administrative arrest for up to fifteen days; for officials, two hundred thousand to six hundred thousand roubles; for legal entities, five hundred thousand to one million roubles.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 20.2 · “shall entail an administrative fine of one hundred fifty…”

units.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket
units.text: 8. Repeated commission of an administrative offence provided for by parts 1 - 6.1 of this Article, if this act does not constitute a criminally punishable act —

Violation by the organizer of a public event of the established procedure for collecting, returning, transferring to federal budget revenue or spending funds for organizing and conducting the public event; failure to submit, or late submission to the authorized body of, a report on the use of money and/or other property collected for organizing and conducting the public event, or submission of an incomplete or distorted report —
units.label: Part 9 Art. 20.2

units.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket

units.text: 10. Transferring (handing over) money and/or other property for organizing and conducting a public event by a person who, under federal law, is not entitled to transfer (hand over) money and/or other property for those purposes —

units.locator: Article 20.2. Violation of the established procedure for organizing or conducting an assembly, rally, demonstration, march or picket
